# burner

> Give your AI assistant a physical side phone.

burner hands an AI assistant a real, dedicated Android phone it can see and touch:
read the screen as a UI tree, tap, type, open deep links, take screenshots, and
pull email verification codes. One CLI: `burner`. Use it for apps with no API, no
MCP server, and bot-blocking web flows (marketplaces, banking, social, store
apps).

## Install

curl -fsSL https://useburner.si/install.sh | bash

Installs to ~/burner (or $BURNER_DIR). No sudo. Safe to re-run.

## For agents

- Read the full skill first: https://useburner.si/skill.md
- Pairing the phone needs a human once, about 10 minutes (`burner setup` guides it).
  After that, reboots need no human action.
- Codes come from email, never SMS. Never buy, send, or post without explicit
  human approval for that specific action.
